title: Huawei watch 1- xdrip app no longer in watch play store
body: I have been using an lg g4 running marshmallow to run xdrip+. I was also using a Huawei watch classic, with the xdrip watch face(s).  My transmitter died, I replaced the batteries,  and it continued to work. However the LG had issues and needed to be replaced. Then the watch seemed to be creating conflicts in xdrip, and it kept saying that xdrip app needed to be updated. So i stopped using the watch, and ordered a galaxy s9. Today, i successfully loaded xdrip+ on the galaxy,  and imported my history i to the app. I wanted to use my watch,  i paired it successfully,  but when I tried to install the xdrip watch app from the watch play store, no dice. Google seems to have removed it. Is there any other way to load the xdrip app to a watch, and anywhere besides the play store to get it? Thanks for all your amazing work. I used to use spike app until apple made it impossible.
